task: show me how to change the cursor type

evidence.description: Brand-wide Screen Clip Settings page is open with the Cursor Style dropdown expanded, listing the selectable cursor types

summary:
Here's how to change the cursor type in Yarn (brand-wide default — the broadest scope):

1. In the left sidebar (bottom), click **Brand Kit**.
2. In the Brand Kit nav column, choose **Screen Clips** — this opens the **Screen Clip Settings** page for "Default Brand".
3. In the **Cursor** section, click the **Cursor Style** dropdown (currently set to *Pointer-first*).
4. Pick the cursor type you want: **Arrow-first**, **Pointer-first**, or **Original**. The choice applies immediately — no save button.

Related cursor controls on the same page: Auto-Hide Cursor (Auto Hide / Off), Text Cursor (Hide / Show) and Cursor Scale.

I left the dropdown open showing the three options rather than changing the value, since no specific cursor type was requested. Note the scope: this is the brand default. To change it for a single project only, open that project → **Project actions (⋯)** next to the voice picker → **Screen Clip Settings…** → set Cursor Style there → **Done**; that override is stored separately from the brand default.
